verdict.rationale: Pigment, a planning SaaS, mentions only that it can be 'integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports,' which suggests some programmatic, non-UI automation. Nothing documents a CLI, CI usage, or headless execution of model runs, and no OpenAPI spec was found. The MCP server serves interactive assistants rather than headless pipelines, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented CLI or headless run mode, CI/pipeline integration guidance, published API reference/spec for triggering model calculations or imports programmatically, independent or hands-on corroboration.
